form.assetNumberInfo: Unique identifier for this asset in your register (e.g. FA-001).
form.acquisitionCostInfo: Total cost to acquire or construct the asset, including installation.
form.salvageValueInfo: Estimated residual value at the end of the asset's useful life.
form.usefulLifeMonthsInfo: Expected productive life of the asset in months, used to calculate depreciation.
form.depreciationMethodInfo: The accounting method used to allocate the asset's cost over its useful life.
